en.headline: Labour Department job fair offers over 2,200 vacancies for ethnic minorities
en.dek: The two-day event at MacPherson Stadium in Mong Kok on 16 and 17 September is free and includes on-the-spot interviews for a wide range of roles.
body: The Labour Department will hold a job fair aimed at ethnic minority job seekers at MacPherson Stadium in Mong Kok on Wednesday and Thursday.

About 50 organisations will offer more than 2,200 vacancies across sectors including engineering, retail, transport, hospitality and security. Around 86 per cent of the posts are full-time, most with monthly salaries between HK$12,000 and HK$24,000, and the majority require Secondary Six education or below.

The fair runs from 11am to 5.30pm each day near Mong Kok MTR Exit E2. Admission is free and applicants can submit applications and attend interviews on the spot. Career talks are also scheduled for the first day.

zh.headline: 勞工處招聘會提供逾二千二百職位 便利少數族裔求職
zh.dek: 周三及周四於旺角麥花臣場館舉行，約五十間機構參與，大部分為全職，月薪介乎1.2萬至2.4萬元，入場免費。
body: 勞工處將於本周三及周四在旺角麥花臣場館舉行共創多元文化工作間招聘會，協助少數族裔等求職人士就業。
約五十間機構參與，提供逾二千二百個職位，涵蓋工程、零售、運輸、餐飲及保安等。約百分之八十六為全職，大部分月薪介乎一萬二千至二萬四千元，約百分之九十六要求中六或以下學歷。
招聘會每日上午十一時至下午五時半舉行，近旺角港鐵站E2出口，費用全免，求職者可即場遞交申請及面試。首日亦設就業講座。
